title: Strict bound at recursive depth two
statement: For the depth-two recursive majority function on $3^2$ signs, the randomized decision-tree complexity, measured by the infimum of the worst-case expected number of queried coordinates among finite-seed, zero-error randomized decision trees, is strictly less than $(8/3)^2$.
